Follow the 2026 US midterm elections live as millions of Americans head to the polls to vote for members of Congress.
Track key races in the House of Representatives and Senate, see which candidates are leading and follow the battle for control of Congress.
435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 of the Senate’s 100 seats are up for election. The results will determine which party controls Congress.
